events.title: Ivan IV Crowned First Tsar of Russia
events.description: Ivan IV, known as Ivan the Terrible, was crowned in the Dormition Cathedral in Moscow, becoming the first ruler to be formally crowned with the title Tsar of All Russia.
events.significance: The coronation elevated the status of the Muscovite ruler, laid the foundation for the Russian Tsardom, and shaped Russian autocratic rule for centuries.

events.title: First Edition of Don Quixote Published
events.description: The first part of Miguel de Cervantes' novel El ingenioso hidalgo don Quijote de la Mancha was published in Madrid, though the exact date is traditionally cited as around this time following its licensing in late 1604.
events.significance: Often regarded as the first modern novel and one of the greatest works of fiction, it profoundly influenced Western literature.

events.title: Prohibition Begins in the United States
events.description: The Eighteenth Amendment to the U.S. Constitution took effect, banning the manufacture, sale, and transportation of intoxicating liquors nationwide.
events.significance: Prohibition led to the rise of organized crime and bootlegging, and was repealed in 1933 by the Twenty-first Amendment, serving as a lasting lesson in the limits of legislating social behavior.

events.title: Operation Desert Storm Begins
events.description: A U.S.-led coalition launched a massive air campaign against Iraq, beginning the Gulf War following Iraq's invasion and occupation of Kuwait in August 1990 (it began January 17 local time in the Persian Gulf, evening of January 16 in the US).
events.significance: The war liberated Kuwait, showcased advanced precision military technology, and reshaped U.S. involvement and geopolitics in the Middle East.

events.title: Shah of Iran Leaves the Country
events.description: Mohammad Reza Pahlavi, the Shah of Iran, fled Iran amid widespread protests and unrest, leaving the country under a regency council.
events.significance: His departure marked a decisive turning point in the Iranian Revolution, leading to the end of the monarchy and the establishment of the Islamic Republic under Ayatollah Khomeini.
